meta.title: How It Works — Japanese TCG Proxy Buying
meta.description: How Kangaroo Japan proxy buying works for U.S. collectors and resellers: search Japanese listings, we buy in Japan, inspect and consolidate, then ship to the U.S. with tracking.

hero.title: From a Japanese listing to your door
hero.subtitle: We're your buying agent in Japan. Find the card, we purchase it locally, inspect and consolidate it, then ship it to the United States. Here's the full flow.

steps.title: Four steps to your cards
steps.subtitle: Simple from start to finish. You stay in control at every stage.

search.title: Search cards
search.body: Search live Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh listings across Mercari, Yahoo Auctions and Amazon Japan, or paste a listing link for any card you want — including sellers who don't ship internationally.

buy.title: We buy in Japan
buy.body: Our team in Japan places the order or bids on your behalf, communicates with the seller, and receives the item at our warehouse. You pay an estimated total up front; auctions are won at your set limit.

inspect.title: Inspect & consolidate
inspect.body: We log each item, translate the seller's Japanese condition notes into English, and can take inspection photos on request. Buy from several sellers and we consolidate everything into one parcel.

ship.title: Ship to the U.S.
ship.body: Your consolidated, TCG-safe package ships to your U.S. address with tracking. International shipping is priced by actual weight and the method you choose at checkout.

estimates.title: Fees are estimated until checkout
estimates.body: Item price, Japan domestic shipping, our service fee and international postage are shown as estimates. Your exact, itemized total is always confirmed at checkout.

manual.title: Some listings need manual entry
manual.body: A few sources can't be fetched automatically. Send the full listing link, quantity and variant, and once we confirm availability we'll create the order for you to pay.

customs.title: U.S. customs may apply
customs.body: As of 2025 the U.S. removed the $800 de minimis exemption, so any import can be assessed duty or tax by U.S. Customs. We declare the actual value honestly and never under-declare.

cta.title: Ready to pull from Japan?
cta.body: Search live listings across Japanese marketplaces and let us handle the buying, inspection and shipping.
